facts.sea-throne: The king sits facing front on a stone throne set on the sea.
facts.cup-scepter: In his right hand he holds a large cup, and in his left a short scepter.
facts.fish-amulet: A fish-shaped ornament hangs from his neck.
facts.dolphin-ship: A fish leaps up from the sea on the left, and a ship floats on the right.
facts.robes: He wears a green cloak over blue clothes and a crown.

glosses.sea-throne: Keeping his center even above the heaving feelings.
glosses.cup-scepter: A hand that holds feeling and responsibility together.

reversedGloss.internalized: Pressing feelings down and staying calm only on the outside.
reversedGloss.excess: Feelings shake judgment, and he becomes moody.

misdescriptions.wrong: The king is riding in a ship.
The king is submerged in the water.
